items.stem: The objective of an external audit of financial statements is to:

options.text: Provide reasonable assurance that the statements are free from material misstatement
options.rationale: Correct: an audit provides reasonable (not absolute) assurance on material misstatement.

options.text: Guarantee the statements are completely accurate
options.rationale: Audits provide reasonable, not absolute, assurance.
Audits are not designed to detect all fraud.

items.explanation: Correct: an audit provides reasonable (not absolute) assurance on material misstatement.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which of the following best describes audit risk?

options.text: The risk that the auditor expresses an inappropriate opinion when the statements are materially misstated
options.rationale: Correct: audit risk is the risk of an inappropriate opinion on materially misstated statements.

options.text: The risk that the client becomes insolvent
options.rationale: That is business/going-concern risk, not audit risk as defined.

options.text: The risk of losing the audit engagement
options.rationale: That is a commercial risk, not audit risk.

options.text: The risk that staff are under-trained
options.rationale: That is an operational risk within the firm.

items.explanation: Correct: audit risk is the risk of an inappropriate opinion on materially misstated statements.

items.stem: Select TWO components of audit risk under the audit risk model.

options.rationale: Correct: inherent risk is a component of audit risk.
Correct: detection risk is a component of audit risk.
Operational risk is not part of the audit risk model.
Liquidity risk is a financial risk, not part of the model.
Reputational risk is not a component of the audit risk model.
